slots.name: participating countries
slots.sentence: As one of the 31 participating countries, Germany was shocked to discover that its 15-year-olds scored below the international average.

slots.name: test participants
slots.sentence: In 2025, more than 760,000 students in 91 countries and economies took the test.

slots.name: low performer share
slots.sentence: The latest PISA study reveals that around 29% of 15-year-olds in OECD countries are now estimated to be "low performers" across all three subjects.

slots.name: school variation
slots.sentence: In some countries, such as Iceland, Cambodia and Finland, for example, there is very little variation in performance among schools, showing less than 10% overall variation in student achievement.

slots.name: AI use share
slots.sentence: more than 40% said they used it to draft texts for writing assignments once or twice a week, or even every day.

slots.name: parent support gain
slots.sentence: Even something as simple as asking children what they learned or did at school, about once a week or more, is associated with an average 26-point increase in science performance, after accounting for socio-economic status.

slots.name: OECD comparison group
slots.sentence: The study always includes in its ranking the average of the international group of 38 advanced, high-income countries that are part of the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development, the OECD.

slots.name: publication date
slots.sentence: The results of the 2025 PISA study, published on September 8, show a dramatic drop in performance in reading and mathematics around the world.

slots.name: extreme reading drop
slots.sentence: Among the OECD countries, the drops were most extreme in Iceland and Slovenia, with scores going down by more than 50 points.

slots.name: countries reading improved
slots.sentence: Reading scores improved in five countries only: Qatar (up 11 points), Brunei Darussalam (18), Cambodia (26), the Philippines (27) and Zambia (50).

slots.name: high school variation countries
slots.sentence: But in 10 countries, including Germany, differences among schools account for at least 50% of the total variation in performance.

slots.name: top reading rankings
slots.sentence: The top six rankings in reading skills are held by Asian countries.

slots.name: Germany reading rank
slots.sentence: Germany barely remains above the OECD average, coming in 24th.
